layouts.name: Monza
layouts.description: Main road course through Variante del Rettifilo, Variante della Roggia, both Lesmo corners, Variante Ascari and Curva Alboreto. The historic banked oval, Junior loop and chicane bypasses are excluded.

layouts.name: Monza Combo
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Monza, Monza without Chicane. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Monza without Chicane
layouts.description: Draft route hypothesis: the source cycle is the unique closest nominal-distance match within conservative timing and distance checks. Approximate OSM trace length 5751.3 m. Difference from the supplied layout distance 26.3 m. Course configuration still requires visual review.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap raceway snapshot
sources.evidenceNote: Pinned, sanitized Overpass snapshot. Exact source way versions and slices are recorded in the layout recipes. Geometry comes only from OSM.

sources.title: FIA licensed circuit list, 1 December 2025
sources.evidenceNote: Supports venue and main-circuit identification only. No coordinates are copied or traced from this document. Alternative layout labels follow the named OSM branches and local timing catalogue; they remain drafts.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap connected course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact source-node geometry from the pinned country extract. Configuration is a draft match using a private timing position and nominal layout distance.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap identified course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact pinned source ways from the component recipes; independent paths have no invented joins.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: Aggregate configuration shows the combined mapped branches of Monza, Monza without Chicane. The catalogue configuration picture identifies the same perimeter, connector and infield branches. Component route recipes retain their independent identification evidence; timing locations and branch identity remain drafts. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
